paper_id: Hu et al. - 2005 - Efficient Information Service Management Using Service Club in CROWN Grid
title: Efficient Information Service Management Using Service Club in CROWN Grid
motivation: CROWN Grid suffers from poor scalability, long search response time, and huge traffic overhead when users flood the GIS mesh network for service discovery
problem_framing: How to organize GISs in a mesh network to restrict service search to relevant nodes rather than flooding all GISs
key_insight: Build an overlay of service clubs where GISs sharing the same popular service types are tightly connected via MST, limiting search scope and traffic
method_signature: S-Club overlay organizes GISs into service-type-specific clubs using MST topology, frequency thresholds, and distributed maintenance
evaluation_criteria: Average response time, total traffic overhead, and optimization ratio compared to MDS-like flooding baseline
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Intuitively, too many clubs may bring much maintenance overhead; MST topology suffers from single-point-failure
evidence_for_taste: no existing approaches can provide efficient information service
Intuitively, too many clubs may bring much maintenance overhead
There exists a best value of α to maximize the benefit
MST may assure all the club members are connected while get minimum traffic cost
This method can not assure the member topology to be a MST
S-Club reduces traffic by 55% and average response time by 27%
thinking_moves: 把服务类型聚类问题转化为overlay拓扑构建与维护问题
引入可调频率阈值来平衡俱乐部数量与维护开销
复用分布式系统协议(Narada)来处理成员动态变化
承认MST单点故障问题并采用spanning tree容忍故障
通过simulation验证参数敏感性与系统可扩展性
